title: The recorded intrinsic compact scalar arrow has its fixed-module proper/open normal form
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative unital rings and φ:A→B a unital homomorphism. For schemes X,Y and a compactification c=(X→Z→Y) [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let J_A be exact fixed-module pro-etale extension by zero along c.i and R_A the fixed-module derived direct image along c.g [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]. Work with fixed modules over ULift A and ULift B and their intrinsic realization equivalences [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Write T for fixed scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. Let γ:T_Y R_A→R_B T_Z be the geometric counit mate of scalarPullbackProEtaleIso [lem-sfb-scalar-site-comparison-normalized-data], and s:T_Z J_A≅J_B T_X the composite-left-adjoint uniqueness comparison OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen [lem-sp-open-scalar-site-coherence]. Then the genuine transported recorded intrinsic coefficient arrow [def-sp-et-proet-coefficient-transport, def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison] is exactly γ evaluated after J_A followed by R_B(s). This is equality of natural transformations on the entire fixed-module pro-etale derived category; there is no etale-origin or boundedness hypothesis, and no assertion of invertibility of γ or of the coefficient arrow.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings, proper/open factorization; the agent-written realization normalization of Step 3 of lem-sp-transported-compact-scalar-site-square, expanding the Charts paragraph of literature/blueprint/latest/blueprint/sec-smooth-purity/sk-lem-sp-reduction/sk-lem-sp-reduction-exceptional.proof.md.

proof.text: Apply the fully faithful intrinsic realization functor at Y to identify the fixed-module composite γ after J_A followed by R_B(s) with transport of the recorded intrinsic reduction comparison. The fully faithful preimage equation expands its image as the scalar presentation inverse, support presentation inverse, recorded arrow, scalar presentation hom and support presentation hom. For the proper factor, the direct-image presentation changes adjunction coordinates by the unique pullback comparison preserving units, followed by the K-injective-normalized realization comparison. Transpose under the geometric adjunction: the resulting counit equation is precisely that of the fixed-module proper scalar mate. For the open factor, cancel the realization unit in supportPresentation. The open coordinate isomorphism is left-adjoint uniqueness, hence its scalar map agrees with reductionOpenScalarIso by equality of their open-unit transposes. The section-identity comparison defining scalarPresentation preserves the scalar adjunction units, so these proper and open identifications paste without an extra automorphism. Cancel the realization unit/counit pairs and use faithfulness to descend equality. This proves the equality of natural transformations by extensionality; only presentation isomorphisms have been inverted, never a coefficient mate. No change of site is involved in this step.

lean.statement:
theorem recordedCompactScalar_fixed_normalization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) :
    transportedRecordedReductionDirectImageComparison φ c
        (reductionDirectImageComparison φ c.i c.g) =
      whiskerLeft
          (openImmersionLowerShriek
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) c.i).mapDerivedCategory
          (mateEquiv
            (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) c.g)
            (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) c.g)
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (scalarPullbackProEtaleIso (uliftRingHom φ) c.g).hom)).natTrans ≫
        whiskerRight (OpenScalarSite.scalarOpen (uliftRingHom φ) c.i).hom
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) c.g).rightDerivedFunctor
